name: KinBridge
tagline: The coordination layer for independent home-care agencies.
positioning: KinBridge unifies care plans, caregiver schedules, and family updates into one operational record — built for owner-operators running lean home-care businesses.

hero.h1: Run your entire home-care agency from one clear record.
hero.sub: KinBridge connects care plans, caregiver shifts, and family communication so nothing falls through the cracks between visits — no spreadsheets, no group texts, no guessing.

features.title: Live care plans
features.description: Every client's medication schedule, mobility notes, and standing instructions in one versioned record every caregiver sees before the shift starts.

features.title: Shift handoffs that stick
features.description: Outgoing caregivers log observations and open tasks; the next caregiver arrives already briefed. No more 7am phone calls to catch up.

features.title: Family updates on autopilot
features.description: Adult children get a clean daily summary of visits, meals, and mood — so your office phone stops ringing with the same three questions.

features.title: Incident reporting
features.description: Falls, missed doses, and hospital transfers documented with timestamps and photos, ready for audits and payer reviews.

features.title: Schedule coverage
features.description: See open shifts, credential gaps, and overtime risk across your roster before they become a Monday-morning emergency.

features.title: Compliance-ready records
features.description: Export EVV logs and visit documentation that hold up to state and payer scrutiny without a scramble.

testimonials.quote: We went from four disconnected tools to one. My coordinators stopped chasing caregivers for notes, and I finally trust that the family updates actually went out.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The shift handoff feature paid for itself in the first month. Our caregivers show up informed, and our client retention has never been higher.
testimonials.name: Darnell Foster

testimonials.quote: When our state audit came, we exported everything in under an hour. Before KinBridge that would have been a two-week paper hunt.
testimonials.name: Priya Nair
